resources.string: Day 1: Full Body Strength Training - Warm-up with jumping jacks, arm circles, high knees. Do squats (3x12), push-ups (3x10), bent-over rows (3x12), lunges (3x10 per leg). Cool down with leg and arm stretches.

Day 2: Cardio and Core - Warm-up with marching in place, butt kicks, dynamic stretching. Jog or walk briskly for 20 minutes. Do bicycle crunches (3x15), leg raises (3x12), and plank holds (3x30-45 sec). Finish with core-focused stretches.
Day 3: Active Recovery - 20-minute light walk or gentle yoga session focusing on full-body stretching.
Day 4: Lower Body Strength - Warm-up with leg swings and bodyweight squats. Do glute bridges (3x15), Bulgarian split squats (3x10 per leg), and calf raises (3x20). Finish with lower body stretches.
Day 5: Upper Body Strength - Warm-up with arm circles and shoulder taps. Perform dumbbell shoulder presses (3x12), bicep curls (3x12), and tricep dips (3x12). Cool down with upper body stretches.

Day 6: Cardio Blast - Warm-up with high knees and side-to-side shuffles. Perform a HIIT session (30 sec work, 15 sec rest) for 5 rounds with mountain climbers, burpees, jump squats, and skaters. Finish with full-body stretching.
Day 7: Yoga and Flexibility - 30-minute guided yoga session focused on relaxation and flexibility.
Day 8: Full Body Strength + Abs - Warm-up with 5 minutes of cardio. Do deadlifts (3x12), push-ups (3x12), and side planks (3x30 sec per side). Finish with stretching focused on abs and back.
Day 9: Cardio and Core Combo - Warm-up with dynamic core exercises. Do a 15-minute interval run, Russian twists (3x20), and flutter kicks (3x30 sec). Cool down with core stretches.
Day 10: Mobility Work - Perform 20 minutes of mobility exercises, including hip openers and arm circles. Finish with deep breathing exercises.
Day 11: Full Body Strength Training - Repeat Day 1 with added reps or weights for progression.
Day 12: Cardio and Core - Repeat Day 2 with increased intensity or duration.
Day 13: Active Recovery - Light yoga or a 20-30 minute walk focusing on relaxation.
Day 14: Rest Day - Complete rest to allow full recovery. Focus on hydration and proper nutrition.
Day 15: Lower Body Strength - Repeat Day 4 with variations such as sumo squats or weighted lunges.
Day 16: Upper Body Strength - Repeat Day 5 with new exercises like lateral raises or push-up variations.
Day 17: Cardio Blast - Repeat Day 6 with additional rounds or sprint intervals for added challenge.
Day 18: Yoga and Flexibility - 30-minute yoga session focusing on deep stretches and full-body relaxation.
Day 19: Full Body Strength + Abs - Repeat Day 8 with increased reps or added weights.
Day 20: Cardio and Core Combo - Repeat Day 9 with longer cardio sessions or additional core exercises.
Day 21: Mobility Work - 30-minute mobility routine focusing on tight muscle groups.
Day 22: Full Body Strength Training - Repeat Day 11 with slight exercise variations or increased sets.
Day 23: Cardio and Core - Repeat Day 12 with more core exercise time or intensity.
Day 24: Active Recovery - Light stretching or a 20-minute casual walk for muscle relaxation.
Day 25: Lower Body Strength - Repeat Day 15 with resistance band exercises or added weights.
Day 26: Upper Body Strength - Repeat Day 16, adding incline push-ups or additional sets.
Day 27: Cardio Blast - Repeat Day 17 with increased interval times or more HIIT exercises.
Day 28: Rest Day - Full rest day to recover, with focus on hydration and nutrition.
Day 29: Full Body Strength + Abs - Repeat Day 19 with superset exercises for a final challenge.
Day 30: Yoga and Flexibility - 45-minute full-body yoga session focusing on flexibility and relaxation.
